name: Grounded camera and authored shots
body: Dean (2026-11-17): Companion Navigation, Camera and Animation are the main things now. The game is an action-adventure in the style of The Last of Us with no combat, so the camera should read as a film camera: it follows smoothly, leads the player's movement, sits over a shoulder, never clips through walls, and level designers can author places where it changes (a volume) or cuts to a framed shot. Engine in Nox, game code in Nyx, with a small clean API between them. The collision sphere-cast from the third-person camera is kept.
